mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 1 month does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters indicates a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters but does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% MoM does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 8% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase, it signals a labor market recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE > 8% and PAYEMS increases but does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% year-over-year signals a weakening demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST decreases > 10% YoY does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 2% annualized, it signals accommodative monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy with inflationary pressure
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2% does not lead to positive 5-day forward returns in > 70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real final sales of domestic product (RSAFS) over two consecutive quarters signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases for two consecutive quarters but does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
